note: Dated events for this scenario, drawn only from mechanics the engine already has. Dates are the year and the week of that year. Magnitudes follow docs/rules/CONTENT-PACING.md. Titles and summaries are fictional framing with no real company or person names.

events.title: The central bank squeezes money
events.summary: The central bank is fighting inflation with very high rates. Lenders ration credit and borrowers feel it first.

events.title: A rig-lending bank fails
events.summary: A mid-sized bank that lent heavily against drilling rigs collapses. Other lenders pull back from oil credit and the whole region gets nervous.

events.title: Banks cut oil lending
events.summary: Banks that survived the failure shrink their oil books. Loans cost more and take longer to arrange.

events.title: A new Gulf gas pipeline opens
events.summary: A long gas pipeline to the Gulf coast opens. More gas reaches the water, ports take more of it and local gas prices ease.

events.title: Oil prices collapse
events.summary: Producers abroad open the taps and the price of oil falls through the floor. Drillers shut rigs and the whole region feels it.

events.title: The savings and loan crisis deepens
events.summary: Savings institutions that lent against property and oil are failing one after another. Lending retreats and the central bank eases to cushion the fall.

events.title: The state starts buying oil for storage
events.summary: With prices low, the state begins buying and storing commodities to prop up the market until it recovers.

events.title: The oil patch steadies
events.summary: Rig counts stop falling and exporters return to the market. Spending creeps back across the region.
